generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Subaru twin of the Toyota C-HR (battery-electric, e-TNGA): 74.7 kWh pack, FWD or AWD, NACS, up to 150 kW DC, 11 kW AC. NRCan lists "Uncharted" (399 km) and "Uncharted Long Range" (496 km), which suggests a smaller pack (about 57.7 kWh per CarGurus) on the Canadian base car; US sources say 74.7 kWh on all, so check per market at the powertrain step. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://media.subaru.com/pressrelease/2334/1/subaru-debuts-all-new-all-electric-2026-subaru ; https://cargurus.ca/research/2026-Subaru-Uncharted-c34278
